summary.headline: Q1 FY27 total income rose 10% YoY to INR146 crores and PAT 7% to INR23 crores, while net debt climbed to INR614 crores.
summary.overview:
Management reported Q1 FY27 total income of INR146 crores (up 10% YoY) and EBITDA of INR55 crores (up 9%, margin near 37.5%). Sales value rose 74% YoY to INR141 crores on 28,834 sq ft sold, but collections fell to INR86 crores from INR115 crores. Net debt rose to INR614 crores, which management attributed to Bandra land, the Dadar West acquisition and project investments. Management guided to a FY27 launch pipeline of about INR1,600 crores and presales of about INR700 crores.</overview>

segments.name: Suraj One Business Bay (Mahim, commercial)
segments.commentary: About 33% of inventory sold since launch; management says it is the largest contributor to sales and collections over the next 2-3 quarters. Average realisation about INR50,000 per sq ft, per Q&A.

segments.name: Residential (Suraj Nova / Lobo Villa, Mahim)
segments.commentary: Expected launch in Q2 with about INR180 crores top line; CC and RERA expected soon. Residential unsold inventory is about 22,000 sq ft, GDV about INR109 crores.

segments.name: Ongoing portfolio overall
segments.commentary: Cumulative sold area 5.95 lakh sq ft at average realisation about INR45,922 per sq ft; cumulative collections INR1,672 crores; balance receivable about INR1,060 crores.

segments.name: Commercial unsold inventory
segments.commentary: About 1.4 lakh sq ft unsold, estimated top line INR841 crores. Total unsold inventory across ongoing projects about INR950 crores.

guidance_outlook: FY27 launch pipeline about INR1,600 crores: about INR240 crores in Q2, INR800-880 crores in Q3, about INR480 crores in Q4.
FY27 presales target about INR700 crores across residential and commercial; at least 1 lakh sq ft more to be sold in One Business Bay.
Accounting revenue growth of about 10-15% over FY26, subject to launch timing.
EBITDA margin guided at 35-37% for the next two years.

Bandra project: two balance conveyances pending; launch in FY28. Premiums estimated at INR300-350 crores for the entire land parcel, funded initially from internal accruals; construction debt facility to be arranged later.
Debt expected to rise temporarily with launches, then decline on a sustainable basis; no quantified de-leveraging target given.
capex_capacity: Suraj One Business Bay Phase 2 (amalgamated into current phase, INR800 crores top line) expected Q3 FY27, pending RERA amendment; concession plan for amalgamated portion already approved.
Shivteerth (Shivaji Park, INR80 crores top line) expected Q3 FY27; Madonna (Dadar, INR60 crores top line) expected in FY27.
Three further projects with about INR480 crores top line expected in Q4 FY27.
Bandra: adjoining third land parcel amalgamation pending; management targets completion before FY27 end but gave no firm timeline. Amalgamation depends on BMC process.
Dadar West land parcel acquired for about INR18 crores; about 18,000 sq ft saleable, GDV about INR100 crores.
demand_pricing: Residential sales growth in Q1 described as low-inventory driven rather than market slowdown, per management.
Management says no increase in redevelopment acquisition costs yet, though competition is rising; deal terms described as standard with limited additional area to societies.
Luxury segment has little ongoing inventory; the Value Luxury and commercial segments are seeing traction.
Management expects pricing appreciation in One Business Bay once the project reaches RCC stage; current focus is on velocity.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 launch pipeline, and which projects drive sales and collections over the next 2-3 quarters?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR1,600 crores of launches (INR240 crores Q2, INR800-880 crores Q3, INR480 crores Q4). Commercial (One Business Bay) is the largest near-term contributor, with Suraj Nova also expected to generate cash flows soon.

qa_highlights.question: What is the funding plan and capital need for the Bandra project?
qa_highlights.answer: Premiums estimated at INR300-350 crores for the entire parcel, funded initially from internal accruals. A construction finance limit is separate and will be arranged closer to launch once basic IOD is in place.

qa_highlights.question: What are the FY27 revenue and EBITDA margin expectations?
qa_highlights.answer: Revenue growth of close to 10-15% over FY26 is expected, subject to launch timing. EBITDA margin is guided at 35-37%.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 presales guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR700 crores in total across residential and commercial, with at least 1 lakh sq ft more to be sold in One Business Bay.

qa_highlights.question: What is the unsold inventory breakdown?
qa_highlights.answer: Residential about 22,000 sq ft (GDV about INR109 crores). Commercial about 1.4 lakh sq ft (top line about INR841 crores). Total about INR950 crores.

qa_highlights.question: What is the timeline for the Bandra third plot amalgamation?
qa_highlights.answer: No firm timeline. Conveyances for the two balance plots come first; management targets completion before FY27 end but says this is not assured.

risks_watch: Collections fell 25% YoY to INR86 crores while sales value rose 74%, widening the gap between booked sales and cash received.
Net debt of INR614 crores, with further increases expected before any de-leveraging; management gave no target.
Launch timing depends on RERA amendment for One Business Bay Phase 2 and Suraj Nova CC and RERA approval.
Bandra third land parcel amalgamation has no firm timeline and depends on BMC process and conveyances.
Management declined to give operating cash flow or collections targets on the call.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand and pipeline, with specific launch and presales targets. Cautious and evasive on cash flow and debt: deferred OCF and collections targets offline and gave no quantified de-leveraging path. Timelines for the Bandra third plot were left open.
